verdict.rationale: Poly is an AI file-storage and browsing app, so a plugin or extension marketplace is a fair question for it. The evidence only describes Poly's own official plugin for external agents such as Claude Code, plus its MCP server and CLI. These are outbound integrations into other tools, not a catalog of community plugins that add features to Poly itself. No browsable catalog or community extension installation is documented.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse and install from a large catalog of community plugins/extensions to add features the core app doesn't ship
